_comment: A floor rather than a band, like warm and higher: hot says 'at least this' and yields to anything hotter, so
it costs a scorching Age nothing. The floor sits in the upper part of vanilla's warm band, so a hot Age is
jungle where the air is wet as well as desert, badlands and savanna where it is not; scorching is the word
Everything past the temperature is only offered, since scorching is the word for burnt country under a
furnace sky and hot only the heat: an orange light, an orange or red sun, a shimmer of haze, and
a lean away from the frozen.
